operations.note: The original D005 title block reads6061 Alloy and its note explicitly says Aluminium; D020 and the linked BOM also specify aluminium. Approve the specific alloy as kind_of the broader aluminium family; preserve the literal grade.

The original D011 title block reads7075-T6, Plate (SS), while the source note says Alu. and the linked Recoater Arm BOM records Aluminium. Approve kind_of aluminium; the Plate (SS) stock-label suffix does not make7075-T6 stainless steel.

The original D026 material explicitly says AISI316 Stainless Steel Sheet (SS); the BOM records Stainless steel and Steel. Approve kind_of the broader recorded steel categories; this does not turn the alternative aluminium note into a stainless-only design or choose a thickness.

Directly inspected D015: material Silicon Rubber, title Silikone Wiper and Danish note silikone plade; the matching BOM blade records Silicone and the supplied filename identifies Silicone. In this specific elastomer-wiper context approve kind_of silicone. This does not equate the element silicon with silicone globally.
